the Glu-unresponsive lamina I and II neurons were more excitable than the Glu-responsive ones, that the Glu unresponsiveness was due to an absence of Glu receptors, not an absence of Glutamate, and that the Glu receptors were present on the Glu-unresponsives, but were not functional.
